    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">「小Z的排名」题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="t3小z的排名题解">T3「小Z的排名」题解</h2>
<h3 id="题意简述">题意简述</h3>
<p>有一个 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个点的图，点从 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 编号。对于 <span class="math inline">\(u \lt v\)</span>，若 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 的倍数则连边。每次询问给定 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>，求前 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个点中度数的第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 小值。</p>
<p><a href="https://www.acgo.cn/problemset/info/128885?teamCode=2042058713337094144" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">NOIP8-T3 小 Z 的排名_-ACGO</a></p>
<hr>
<h3 id="度数公式">度数公式</h3>
<p>对于点 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>，它的度数由两部分构成：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>比 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 小的约数</strong>：共有 <span class="math inline">\(d(u) - 1\)</span> 个（<span class="math inline">\(d(u)\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 的约数个数，减去 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 自身）；</li>
<li><strong>比 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 大的倍数</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\le n\)</span> 的倍数有 <span class="math inline">\(\lfloor n/u \rfloor\)</span> 个，减去 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 自身，共 <span class="math inline">\(\lfloor n/u \rfloor - 1\)</span> 个。</li>
</ul>
<p>因此：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\deg(u) = d(u) + \left\lfloor\frac{n}{u}\right\rfloor - 2
\]</div><p></p><hr>
<h3 id="增量维护">增量维护</h3>
<p>当 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 增大到 <span class="math inline">\(n+1\)</span> 时：</p>
<ul>
<li>新点 <span class="math inline">\(n+1\)</span> 的度数为 <span class="math inline">\(\deg(n+1) = d(n+1) - 1\)</span>（此时没有比它大的倍数）；</li>
<li>对于 <span class="math inline">\(n+1\)</span> 的每个约数 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(v \lt n+1\)</span>），<span class="math inline">\(\lfloor (n+1)/v \rfloor = \lfloor n/v \rfloor + 1\)</span>，所以 <span class="math inline">\(\deg(v)\)</span> 增加 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>因此可以把所有询问按 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 排序，从小到大增量处理。每次 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 增加 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>，更新 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 的所有约数对应的度数，并维护度数分布。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="分块求第--小">分块求第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 小</h3>
<p>度数值域最大约为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span>，直接用桶维护每个度数的出现次数 <span class="math inline">\(cnt[x]\)</span>。</p>
<p>将值域按块大小 <span class="math inline">\(B = \sqrt{n}\)</span> 分块，<span class="math inline">\(block[id]\)</span> 记录第 <span class="math inline">\(id\)</span> 块内所有度数的出现次数之和。</p>
<p><strong>加入度数 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span></strong>：<code>cnt[x]++</code>，<code>block[x/B]++</code>。</p>
<p><strong>删除度数 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span></strong>：<code>cnt[x]--</code>，<code>block[x/B]--</code>。</p>
<p><strong>查询第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 小</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>先扫块，找到第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 小落在哪个块（<span class="math inline">\(O(\sqrt{n})\)</span>）；</li>
<li>再扫块内，找到具体度数（<span class="math inline">\(O(B) = O(\sqrt{n})\)</span>）。</li>
</ol>
<p>单次查询 <span class="math inline">\(O(\sqrt{n})\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="线性筛预处理">线性筛预处理</h3>
<p>用线性筛预处理每个数的最小质因数 <span class="math inline">\(spf\)</span>，用于快速求约数列表和约数个数：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(d(1) = 1\)</span>；</li>
<li>对于 <span class="math inline">\(i \gt 1\)</span>，对 <span class="math inline">\(spf[i]\)</span> 的幂次分解，<span class="math inline">\(d(i) = \prod (c+1)\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>枚举约数时，利用 <span class="math inline">\(spf\)</span> 分解质因数，逐层生成所有约数。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="复杂度分析">复杂度分析</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>步骤</th>
<th>复杂度</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>线性筛 <span class="math inline">\(spf\)</span></td>
<td><span class="math inline">\(O(n \log \log n)\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>求所有 <span class="math inline">\(d(i)\)</span></td>
<td><span class="math inline">\(O(n \log n)\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>枚举所有约数（调和级数）</td>
<td><span class="math inline">\(O(n \log n)\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>单次度数更新</td>
<td><span class="math inline">\(O(1)\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>单次查询</td>
<td><span class="math inline">\(O(\sqrt{n})\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>总复杂度</strong></td>
<td><span class="math inline">\(O(n \log n + T \sqrt{n})\)</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h3 id="代码">代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int maxn=8000005;
const int B=1000;

int d[maxn];
int spf[maxn];
int deg[maxn];
int cnt[maxn];
int block[maxn/B+5];

struct Query {
	int n,k,id;
	bool operator &lt; (const Query &amp;b) const {
		return n&lt;b.n;
	}
};

void add_degree(int x) {
	cnt[x]++;
	block[x/B]++;
}

void remove_degree(int x) {
	cnt[x]--;
	block[x/B]--;
}

int query_kth(int k) {
	int blk=0;
	while (block[blk]&lt;k) {
		k-=block[blk];
		blk++;
	}
	for (int i=blk*B;;i++) {
		k-=cnt[i];
		if (k&lt;=0) return i;
	}
}

void get_divisors(int n,vector&lt;int&gt; &amp;divs) {
	divs.clear();
	if (n==1) {
		divs.push_back(1);
		return ;
	}
	divs.push_back(1);
	int temp=n;
	while (temp&gt;1) {
		int p=spf[temp];
		int c=0;
		while (temp%p==0) {
			temp/=p;
			c++;
		}
		int sz=divs.size();
		int mul=1;
		for (int i=0;i&lt;c;i++) {
			mul*=p;
			for (int j=0;j&lt;sz;j++) {
				divs.push_back(divs[j]*mul);
			}
		}
	}
}

struct GenHelper{
	std::mt19937 Rd;
	int N,K;
	void srand(int _S,int _N,int _K){Rd.seed(_S),N=_N,K=_K;}
	int read(){int a=Rd();if(a&lt;0)a=-a;return a;}
	std::pair&lt;int,int&gt; get_nk(){
		int n=read()%N+1,k=read()%(K&lt;n?K:n)+1;
		return std::pair&lt;int,int&gt;(n,k);
	}
}Gen;

void solve() {
	int S,T,N,K;
	cin&gt;&gt;S&gt;&gt;T&gt;&gt;N&gt;&gt;K;
	Gen.srand(S,N,K);
	vector&lt;Query&gt; queries;
	int max_n=0;
	for (int i=0;i&lt;T;i++) {
		Query q;
		std::pair&lt;int,int&gt; nk=Gen.get_nk();
		q.n=nk.first,q.k=nk.second;
		q.id=i;
		queries.push_back(q);
		max_n=max(max_n,q.n);
	}
	
	for (int i=2;i&lt;=max_n;i++) {
		if (!spf[i]) {
			spf[i]=i;
			if ((ll)i*i&lt;=max_n) {
				for (int j=i*i;j&lt;=max_n;j+=i) {
					if (!spf[j]) spf[j]=i;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	d[1]=1;
	for (int i=2;i&lt;=max_n;i++) {
		int temp=i;
		d[i]=1;
		while (temp&gt;1) {
			int p=spf[temp];
			int c=0;
			while (temp%p==0) {
				temp/=p;
				c++;
			}
			d[i]*=(c+1);
		}
	}
	
	sort(queries.begin(),queries.end());
	int qi=0;
	vector&lt;int&gt; ans(T);
	vector&lt;int&gt; divs;
	
	for (int n=1;n&lt;=max_n;n++) {
		get_divisors(n,divs);
		for (int i=0;i&lt;(int)divs.size();i++) {
			int v=divs[i];
			if (v&lt;n) {
				remove_degree(deg[v]);
				deg[v]++;
				add_degree(deg[v]);
			}
		}
		
		deg[n]=d[n]-1;
		add_degree(deg[n]);
		
		while (qi&lt;T &amp;&amp; queries[qi].n==n) {
			ans[queries[qi].id]=query_kth(queries[qi].k);
			qi++;
		}
	}
	
	ll res=0;
	for (int i=0;i&lt;T;i++) res^=ans[i];
	cout&lt;&lt;res&lt;&lt;'\n';
}

signed main() {
	ios::sync_with_stdio(0);
	cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);
	solve();
}
</code></pre>
